title: Unit 5 · Part 1
topic: Go, have, get, Word formation, Past time expressions, The house

words.definition: to arrive at your house
words.example: I usually get home at about 6.30 p.m.
words.example_ru: Я обычно добираюсь домой около 18:30.

words.definition: to arrive at the airport
words.example: It's best to get to the airport two hours before your flight.
words.example_ru: Лучше всего прибыть в аэропорт за два часа до вылета.

words.definition: to get out of bed
words.example: I have to get up early most days.
words.example_ru: Мне приходится вставать рано в большинство дней.

words.definition: to return to a place
words.example: It's difficult to go back to work after a holiday.
words.example_ru: Трудно возвращаться на работу после отпуска.

words.word: go by bus / by car / by plane
words.translation: ехать на автобусе / машине / лететь самолетом
words.definition: to travel using a particular vehicle
words.example: Sometimes I walk to work, but I prefer to go by car.
words.example_ru: Иногда я хожу на работу пешком, но предпочитаю ездить на машине.

words.definition: to walk for pleasure
words.example: Let's go for a walk in the park.
words.example_ru: Давай пойдем гулять в парк.

words.definition: to return to your house
words.example: I go home from school by bike.
words.example_ru: Я возвращаюсь домой из школы на велосипеде.

words.definition: to travel for a vacation
words.example: I want to go on holiday to Mexico.
words.example_ru: Я хочу поехать в отпуск в Мексику.

words.definition: to leave your house to do something enjoyable
words.example: I always go out with my best friends on Friday night.
words.example_ru: Я всегда гуляю со своими лучшими друзьями в пятницу вечером.

words.definition: to go to shops to buy things
words.example: I usually go shopping at the weekend.
words.example_ru: Я обычно хожу за покупками на выходных.

words.definition: to go to a place to eat
words.example: Shall we go to a restaurant tonight?
words.example_ru: Пойдем в ресторан сегодня вечером?

words.definition: to go to a place of worship
words.example: I go to church on Sundays with my grandparents.
words.example_ru: Я хожу в церковь по воскресеньям с бабушкой и дедушкой.

words.definition: to go to the area of sand by the sea
words.example: It's a beautiful, sunny day – let's go to the beach.
words.example_ru: Прекрасный солнечный день — пойдем на пляж.

words.definition: to own a vehicle
words.example: I have a car. It's dark blue.
words.example_ru: У меня есть машина. Она темно-синяя.

words.definition: to drink something, often alcohol
words.example: Shall we have a drink in the bar before we go home?
words.example_ru: Выпьем в баре перед тем, как пойдем домой?

words.definition: to enjoy yourself
words.example: I always have a good time when I go out with Chris.
words.example_ru: Я всегда хорошо провожу время, когда гуляю с Крисом.

words.definition: to eat a sandwich
words.example: I usually have a sandwich for lunch.
words.example_ru: Я обычно ем бутерброд на обед.

words.word: have a shower / a bath / a swim
words.definition: to wash or swim
words.example: I have a shower every morning before breakfast.
words.example_ru: Я принимаю душ каждое утро перед завтраком.

words.definition: to have hair that is long
words.example: You have really long hair.
words.example_ru: У тебя действительно длинные волосы.

words.definition: a person who paints or draws
words.example: Van Gogh was a brilliant artist.
words.example_ru: Ван Гог был блестящим художником.

words.definition: a person who writes music
words.example: Mozart was an excellent composer.
words.example_ru: Моцарт был превосходным композитором.

words.definition: a person who dances
words.example: She is a famous dancer.
words.example_ru: Она известная танцовщица.

words.definition: a person who directs a film or play
words.example: She is a brilliant young film director.
words.example_ru: Она блестящий молодой кинорежиссер.

words.definition: a person who writes novels
words.example: Do you have a favourite novelist?
words.example_ru: У тебя есть любимый романист?

words.definition: a person who paints
words.example: My brother wants to be a painter. He's very good.
words.example_ru: Мой брат хочет быть художником. Он очень хорош.

words.definition: a person who works in politics
words.example: Would you like to be a politician?
words.example_ru: Ты хотел бы быть политиком?

words.definition: a person who works in science
words.example: Stephen Hawking was a scientist.
words.example_ru: Стивен Хокинг был ученым.

words.definition: a person who sings
words.example: Who is your favourite singer?
words.example_ru: Кто твой любимый певец?

words.definition: a person who writes books
words.example: Shakespeare was a famous British writer.
words.example_ru: Шекспир был известным британским писателем.

words.definition: one year before now
words.example: I finished university a year ago.
words.example_ru: Я закончил университет год назад.

words.definition: during the year 2017
words.example: I went there in 2017.
words.example_ru: Я ездил туда в 2017 году.

words.definition: the month before this one
words.example: I went to Germany last month.
words.example_ru: Я ездил в Германию в прошлом месяце.

words.definition: the night before today
words.example: We watched a good show on TV last night.
words.example_ru: Вчера вечером мы смотрели хорошую передачу по телевизору.

words.definition: the summer before this one
words.example: We went to Italy last summer.
words.example_ru: Прошлым летом мы ездили в Италию.

words.definition: the week before this one
words.example: I went to the cinema last week.
words.example_ru: Я ходил в кино на прошлой неделе.

words.definition: two days ago
words.example: I finished the book the day before yesterday.
words.example_ru: Я закончил книгу позавчера.

words.definition: three days before now
words.example: I fell off my bike three days ago.
words.example_ru: Я упал с велосипеда три дня назад.

words.definition: the morning of the day before today
words.example: Where were you at 9.00 a.m. yesterday morning?
words.example_ru: Где ты был в 9 утра вчера?

words.word: at the end of the street
words.definition: the furthest part of a street
words.example: The park is at the end of the street.
words.example_ru: Парк находится в конце улицы.

words.word: Can you tell me the way to...?
words.translation: Вы можете подсказать, как пройти к...?
words.definition: used to ask for directions
words.example: Can you tell me the way to the city centre, please?
words.example_ru: Вы можете подсказать, как пройти в центр города, пожалуйста?

words.definition: the point where two roads meet
words.example: There's a shop on the corner of this road.
words.example_ru: На углу этой дороги есть магазин.

words.word: Could you say that again, please?
words.translation: Не могли бы вы повторить, пожалуйста?
words.definition: used to ask someone to repeat what they said
words.example: Could you say that again, please?
words.example_ru: Не могли бы вы повторить, пожалуйста?

words.definition: used to politely get someone's attention
words.example: Excuse me, please. Where's the nearest supermarket?
words.example_ru: Извините, пожалуйста. Где ближайший супермаркет?

words.definition: further than something
words.example: Go past the library.
words.example_ru: Пройдите мимо библиотеки.

words.definition: continuing in the same direction
words.example: Go straight on down this road.
words.example_ru: Идите прямо по этой дороге.

words.definition: red and green lights that control traffic
words.example: Turn right at the traffic lights.
words.example_ru: Поверните направо на светофоре.

words.definition: to go to the left
words.example: Turn left at the end of this street.
words.example_ru: Поверните налево в конце этой улицы.

words.definition: to go to the right
words.example: Turn right at the traffic lights.
words.example_ru: Поверните направо на светофоре.

words.translation: Вы не можете это пропустить (легко найти).
words.definition: used to say something is easy to find
words.example: It's very big. You can't miss it.
words.example_ru: Это очень большое здание. Вы не сможете его пропустить.

words.definition: used to politely decline an invitation
words.example: Maybe another time? I'm a bit too tired today.
words.example_ru: Может, в другой раз? Я сегодня немного устал.

words.translation: Это очень мило с твоей стороны.
words.definition: used to thank someone for being kind
words.example: I'll buy the tickets. ~ That's really nice of you.
words.example_ru: Я куплю билеты. ~ Это очень мило с твоей стороны.

words.definition: used to suggest a plan
words.example: We could go to the cinema this evening.
words.example_ru: Мы могли бы пойти в кино сегодня вечером.

words.definition: used to say the view is beautiful
words.example: What a view! Those mountains are beautiful.
words.example_ru: Какой вид! Эти горы прекрасны.

words.definition: used to ask about interesting places
words.example: What is there to see in your city?
words.example_ru: Что можно посмотреть в твоем городе?

words.word: What would you like to visit?
words.definition: used to ask about places someone wants to see
words.example: What would you like to visit when you come here?
words.example_ru: Что бы вы хотели посетить, когда приедете сюда?

words.word: Would you like to meet for lunch?
words.translation: Не хотите ли встретиться за обедом?
words.definition: used to invite someone to lunch
words.example: Would you like to meet for lunch at that café?
words.example_ru: Не хотите ли встретиться за обедом в том кафе?

words.definition: used to say yes politely
words.example: Can you help me? ~ Yes, of course.
words.example_ru: Можешь мне помочь? ~ Да, конечно.

words.definition: a system that makes the air in a room cooler
words.example: Is there central heating or air conditioning?
words.example_ru: Есть центральное отопление или кондиционер?

words.definition: a comfortable chair with sides
words.example: There are two sofas and an armchair.
words.example_ru: Там есть два дивана и кресло.

words.definition: a platform outside a window on an upper floor
words.example: Is there a balcony?
words.example_ru: Там есть балкон?

words.definition: a large container you fill with water to wash in
words.example: I had a bath and went to bed.
words.example_ru: Я принял ванну и лег спать.

words.definition: a room with a bath or shower
words.example: Is there a shower in the bathroom?
words.example_ru: В ванной комнате есть душ?

words.definition: a piece of furniture you sleep on
words.example: Each bedroom has a bed, a desk, and a wardrobe.
words.example_ru: В каждой спальне есть кровать, стол и шкаф.

words.definition: a room for sleeping
words.example: This is the biggest bedroom in the house.
words.example_ru: Это самая большая спальня в доме.

words.definition: a thick soft covering for a floor
words.example: Is there a carpet on the floor?
words.example_ru: На полу есть ковер?

words.definition: the top inside surface of a room
words.example: Be careful. The ceiling is very low here.
words.example_ru: Будь осторожен. Здесь очень низкий потолок.

words.definition: a system that heats a whole building
words.example: Is there central heating in the house?
words.example_ru: В доме есть центральное отопление?

words.definition: a large piece of equipment for cooking
words.example: There is a cooker in the kitchen.
words.example_ru: На кухне есть плита.

words.definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves
words.example: Do you keep these glasses in a cupboard?
words.example_ru: Ты хранишь эти стаканы в шкафу?

words.definition: a room for eating meals
words.example: Where is the dining room?
words.example_ru: Где находится столовая?

words.definition: a place in a room where you can have a fire
words.example: There is a fireplace in the living room.
words.example_ru: В гостиной есть камин.

words.definition: the flat surface you walk on inside a room
words.example: Is there a carpet on the floor?
words.example_ru: На полу есть ковер?

words.definition: a large container that keeps food cold
words.example: There is a fridge in the kitchen.
words.example_ru: На кухне есть холодильник.

words.definition: a building where you keep a car
words.example: Oh yes, there's a big garage over there.
words.example_ru: О да, вон там большой гараж.

words.definition: an area with grass and plants next to a house
words.example: I went for a walk in the garden.
words.example_ru: Я пошел гулять в сад.

words.definition: the area just inside the front door of a house
words.example: Put your coats in the hall.
words.example_ru: Повесьте свои пальто в прихожей.

words.definition: a room where you cook food
words.example: Alison likes her kitchen because she can eat there.
words.example_ru: Элисон любит свою кухню, потому что там можно есть.

words.definition: an object that gives light
words.example: There is a lamp on the table.
words.example_ru: На столе есть лампа.

words.definition: the main room in a house for relaxing
words.example: This is the living room. It's quite big and it's very light.
words.example_ru: Это гостиная. Она довольно большая и очень светлая.

words.definition: a piece of glass where you can see yourself
words.example: There is a mirror above the fireplace.
words.example_ru: Над камином есть зеркало.

words.definition: a living thing that grows in soil
words.example: There is a plant in the living room.
words.example_ru: В гостиной есть растение.

words.definition: a flat board on a wall for putting things on
words.example: I have a shelf for books and DVDs.
words.example_ru: У меня есть полка для книг и DVD.

words.definition: a place where you stand to wash under falling water
words.example: I have a shower in the morning.
words.example_ru: Я принимаю душ по утрам.

words.definition: a long soft seat for more than one person
words.example: There is a sofa and an armchair.
words.example_ru: Там есть диван и кресло.

words.definition: steps that go from one floor to another
words.example: The stairs are over there – let's go upstairs.
words.example_ru: Лестница вон там — пойдем наверх.

words.definition: a bowl used for getting rid of body waste
words.example: Is there a toilet downstairs?
words.example_ru: Внизу есть туалет?

words.definition: a machine that washes clothes
words.example: I have four children so I need a washing machine.
words.example_ru: У меня четверо детей, поэтому мне нужна стиральная машина.
